newsitem.title: USA: Dell cuts some PC prices by up to 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dell cuts some PC prices by up to 12 pct.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said on Wednesday that it cut prices by up to 12 percent in the U.S. on its line of OptiPlex corporate personal computers.

The reduction follows last month's price cuts of up to 16 percent on some OptiPlex models, the company said, adding that prices on some of the systems have dropped as much as 56 percent since January.
Dell said the biggest cuts affect 200 megahertz Pentium processors designed for business, government and education customers, which Dell said account for more than 90 percent of its sales.
